deadline.value: International applicants who want a graduate assistantship must apply by December 1; the department FAQ also cites January 1 for international applicants.
deadline.quote: December 1: Deadline for international applicants wanting to be considered for Graduate Assistantships

also.quote: The priority deadline for students requesting financial support for Fall enrollment is Jan. 15 for domestic and Jan.1 for international students

fee_waiver.value: The department offers a limited number of need-based application fee waivers for fall applicants who apply before the priority deadline.
fee_waiver.quote: The department may offer a limited number of need-based application fee waivers for the fall admission cycle before the application priority deadline

gre_general.value: The PhD catalog makes the general GRE optional.
gre_general.quote: The GRE-GEN is optional and the GRE subject test in physics is not required

gre_subject.value: The physics subject GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: the GRE subject test in physics is not required

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by a committee, so admission does not depend on a named faculty supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Applications are reviewed by a committee and admission decisions depend on many factors including departmental needs

funding.value: Most first-year students who need support request a graduate teaching assistantship, which is offered competitively.
funding.quote: These are offered on a competitive basis subject to departmental needs

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree in physics, astronomy or engineering are eligible.
entry_route.quote: Those holding a baccalaureate degree in physics, astronomy, or engineering from an institution of higher education

notes: The department page quotes the university's old TOEFL 88 rule; the university record's new-scale score is used. No separate astronomy PhD in the catalog.
